hero.headline: Invendis
hero.description:
Founded in 2007, Invendis Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. is a global leader in telecom tower monitoring and management solutions, with deployments across more than 150,000 telecom towers in over 30 countries. The company has established a strong reputation for delivering innovative, reliable, and scalable technology solutions that enable critical infrastructure operators to monitor and manage distributed assets efficiently.

Invendis specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of next-generation networking products, including routers, gateways, and switches for mission-critical applications across industries such as financial services, retail, industrial automation, and ATM networks. Its solutions are engineered to deliver high performance, security, and reliability in demanding operating environments.

The company works closely with leading semiconductor and technology partners, MediaTek, Intel, Realtek etc to develop networking devices like Routers, Switches and IoT platforms that addresses emerging connectivity requirements. We work as ODM for many leading brands.

Invendis has also built a portfolio of award-winning edge computing and AI-enabled gateways and servers in collaboration with Intel. These solutions have been deployed at thousands of customer sites, enabling real-time data processing, intelligent automation, and enhanced operational efficiency.

With a strong focus on innovation, product engineering, and global scalability, Invendis with 160+ team strength continues to drive digital transformation across telecommunications, enterprise networking, industrial IoT, and edge computing ecosystems worldwide.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To enable quality products, solutions, and services in the IoT space — covering multiple verticals — with a professional team committed to innovation and customer success.

mission.title: Our Vision
mission.body: To be the global leader in industrial IoT solutions — bridging the physical and digital worlds through intelligent hardware, software platforms, and managed services at scale.

mission.title: Our Tagline
mission.body: Every product and every deployment at Invendis begins with curiosity — and ends with a solution that genuinely transforms how our customers operate.

values.title: Innovation
values.body: Constant R&D investment and design partnerships with MediaTek, Intel, and Qualcomm.

values.title: Partnership
values.body: 9+ year average client relationships. We grow with our customers, not just for them.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, and 27001 certified. 24×7 remote support as standard.

values.title: Global Reach
values.body: Operations, support, and partnerships spanning 54 countries across 4 continents.

timeline.title: Founded in Bangalore
timeline.body: Established by a professional team to deliver quality IoT products across multiple verticals.

timeline.title: First Telecom RMS Order
timeline.body: Secured first order for 1,800 telecom sites across India — validating the core technology.

timeline.title: International Expansion
timeline.body: First overseas order from the Middle East, followed by Africa and Southeast Asia deployments.

timeline.title: Solar Monitoring Launch
timeline.body: Launched dedicated solar monitoring solution, expanding into the energy sector.

timeline.title: Strategic Ericsson Engagement
timeline.body: Deep engagement with Ericsson for bespoke telecom RMS solutions across multiple markets.

timeline.title: Acquisition of ELTRAC Technologies
timeline.body: Added digital energy meters to the portfolio, strengthening the energy measurement vertical.

timeline.title: Acquisition of RELYSYS
timeline.body: Brought in Industrial Communication & Edge Computing capabilities — including SILBO.

timeline.title: Expansion & New Products
timeline.body: Billing and Reconciliation for a Major Saudi Arabia Client
